bio:
Vuyeya is the Implementation Coordinator Consultant at FinMark Trust. Her role involves overseeing the implementation of the GBL Project across seven pilot sites in Gauteng, Free State, and KwaZulu-Natal. With extensive experience in senior management and executive roles, Vuyeya brings valuable expertise in leadership, stakeholder relationship management, and project management to the project.

Notable achievements include her successful work as Head of the Deputy Minister's office at the Department of Social Development and as Head of Government Relations and Regulatory Affairs at Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa. Vuyeya holds a secondary education diploma and an honours degree in English, and has completed several professional development courses, including the Women in Leadership course through GIBS.
name: Vuyeya (Vuyi) Segooa
